description: FreeCAD is open with contact_blocks.FCStd, a real finite element analysis (FEM) contact mechanics model from FreeCAD's test suite. The document contains two separate steel block solids named 'TopBox' and 'BottomBox' that are positioned in contact with each other. Using the Part workbench Boolean Union, merge these two blocks into a single solid. To do this: first click 'TopBox' in the model tree (left panel), then Ctrl+click 'BottomBox' to add it to the selection, then go to Part menu > Boolean > Union (or Part > Boolean Operations). The resulting fused solid should appear in the model tree. Save the result to '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/fused_model.FCStd' using File > Save As.
